entries.title: Startopia
entries.definitive_edition: Startopia on Windows PC digital release

emulation.notes: Use the current Windows digital release. Record any compatibility flags or wrapper if modern Windows needs them.

primary.why: Startopia is a real-time space-station strategy/city-management game released for Windows in 2001. Windows is the platform, with current Steam/GOG digital availability, and no console or alternate-platform gameplay release exists. Windows PC is the definitive route; use the current digital build first, then fall back to original-disc preservation only if the digital build has compatibility issues.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC digital release from Steam or GOG. If needed, document any compatibility wrapper/settings used for modern Windows.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster split was found; Spacebase Startopia is a later separate game already tracked separately.
